local_terms.normative_voice: A Team Membership is an independently lifecycle-managed relation that binds exactly one Person to exactly one Team for a declared interval and participation state.
local_terms.formal_voice: TeamMembership(m) => exactly_one(person_ref(m)) and exactly_one(team_ref(m)); membership(m) does not imply role, responsibility, ownership, permission, or authority.
local_terms.plain_language_voice: Membership says that one person participates in one team; it does not silently say what they may decide or do.
local_terms.domain_context_voice: People and Teams uses membership to preserve joins, leaves, and current participation without rewriting the Team or Person identity.
local_terms.boundary: Not employment, a user group, an access-control grant, a role, a responsibility, or an authority envelope.

local_terms.normative_voice: A Team Role is a named participation expectation scoped to one Team and assignable through an explicit current Team Membership.
local_terms.formal_voice: TeamRole(r) and holds(m, r) =/=> authorized_for(person_ref(m), action).
local_terms.plain_language_voice: A role describes how someone is expected to participate; it is not automatically a permission.
local_terms.domain_context_voice: People and Teams keeps roles visible so Projects and product modules may refer to collaboration expectations without taking authority from the owning system.
local_terms.boundary: Not a job title, permission, policy, identity, ownership record, or authority grant.

local_terms.normative_voice: A Responsibility is a bounded expected outcome or duty assigned to one Person or Team under a named owner and challenge route.
local_terms.formal_voice: Responsibility(x) => exactly_one(responsible_party_ref(x)) and owner_route(x) != empty; responsible_for(p, x) =/=> authorized_for(p, action).
local_terms.plain_language_voice: Responsibility says who must look after an outcome; it does not by itself grant power to change anything.
local_terms.domain_context_voice: People and Teams lets CyberAlchemy attach responsibility to collaboration meaning while leaving decision and execution authority in their separately owned envelopes.
local_terms.boundary: Not authority, accountability proof, permission, task completion, employment duty, or conformance evidence.
